strongest_valid_opposing_point: The four-node focus scene plus directed portal is the smallest real slice that repairs OEW's observed native failure; a launcher merely exposes another surface.
strongest_unsupported_opposing_point: The integrate-now label overshoots its own evidence because the receipt records no owning Work Pack, direct overlap with selected 007T, and required owner selection before mutation.
timing_boundary: Select the exact native focus-scene contract now; defer code incorporation until the 007T ownership and ordering boundary closes.
common_ground: Do not create a second shared dataset.
Reuse the current adapter graph and sidecar.
Select one frozen four-node scene and one literal directed portal.
Resolve 007T ownership before overlapping source mutation.
remaining_disagreement: A launcher remains an optional separately owned discovery feature, not the focus repair and not a currently authorized mutation.
decision_rule: Any change to types.ts, store.ts, or OewApp.tsx requires a named Work Pack owner and an ordering decision that preserves or refreshes 007T bindings.
next_acceptance_boundary: After owner admission, reproduce 237/231, render exact source-derived scene and portal tuples, exclude one unrelated node, and prove input/state parity while retaining gateway negatives, zero outbound requests/errors, and teardown.
claim_ceiling: Bounded design and sequencing condition only.
